DQM2 Offline Compendium — an unofficial, fan-made offline companion for Dragon Quest Monsters 2: Iru and Luca's Marvelous Mysterious Key (3DS / SP).

Monster names, skill names, traits and item names are unofficial English renderings (localised from the Japanese release). Dragon Quest and all related names are trademarks of Square Enix. This app stores no network requests, no trackers and no cookies — only a local favourites list in your browser.
